title: Demonstrate six-way messaging interoperability
description: Run all six permutations of Python/Rust/C sender-relay-recipient plus homogeneous diagnostics using actual production handlers. Test normal delivery, captured link and protected-packet replay, tampering and forward/return path loss. Preserve topology evidence and packet/application correlation on pinned revision. No synthetic receipts, no zero-signature stand-ins, no broad review/task generation loop.
acceptance_criteria: Every mixed permutation proves exact payload acceptance and authenticated correlated delivered receipt; replay does not duplicate delivery; tampering cannot succeed; forward failure has no acceptance, return failure leaves sender unconfirmed. Report precise commands/configs/revision/results.
